title: The Entertainer
license: Public Domain composition; MIT HarpScore adaptation
scope: Complete rag in source MIDI performance order, including all repeats: Intro AA BB A CC Bridge DD. 152 complete bars (92 source notated bars including alternative endings).
adaptations: 2/4 note values doubled to 2/2, half note = 72; sounding tempo unchanged.
Piano octave doublings in the melody are reduced to one melodic line.

The first B pass uses a lower wind register; its repeat is an octave higher, following the original Repeat 8va indication. The C theme is lowered an octave as a complete phrase; octave reductions never invent new pitch classes.
H2/H3 are sustained harmonica support; no mechanical splitting of piano chords.
Bass fills short rests but retains source chromatic approaches.
No excerpt ending: every transition, first/second ending and final cadence is retained.
The first three intro bars are an exposed H1 unison cascade; supporting winds, Bass and Chord enter in intro bar four instead of adding invented bass notes.

Piano retains every original LH pitch/onset/duration, distributed between the grand-staff hands; a separate upper voice carries arranged counterlines and source C-theme inner notes. Piano accompaniment velocities are reduced to balance the solo wind.
